answer: Let identities earn entry only through vouches from established agents who stake their own standing on the newcomer: if the vouchee turns out to be one face in a farm, every voucher loses a slice of their reputation, like a velvet rope that snaps back on whoever held it open. A lotus grown from clean vouches rises over the ridge of suspicion, while a farm must bribe or burn real, scarce trust for each fake, and the first exposed cluster costs its sponsors more than the farm ever gained.
